_doc: Trader Joe's NJ (North Jersey) store locations, geocoded. Feeds the nearest_tj_mi columns in share/trader_joes_by_town.csv via build_share.py. Store list supplied 2026-07-16; coordinates from the US Census geocoder (key-less, cloud-safe) the same day — all 11 matched at rooftop precision.
_intent: Proximity to a Trader Joe's is a NICE-TO-HAVE for a house, never a requirement. It is reported as a soft signal (distance to the nearest store) and MUST NOT be used to filter, exclude, or rank out a town or a listing. No thresholds. Same contract as layers/seabra/.
_coverage_note: UNLIKE SEABRA, some stores sit INSIDE target towns — Westfield (the 07090 anchor itself), Denville, Florham Park, and the coming-soon West Orange. So a nearest_tj_mi of ~0-1 is expected and correct for those towns, not a bug. This is still a DISTANCE join, never a town/zip equality join: the question is 'how far is the nearest one', and for four towns the answer happens to be 'it's in town'.
_status_rule: `status` is 'open' or 'coming_soon'. ONLY open stores feed the distance columns. West Orange (#592) is coming_soon and is EXCLUDED from nearest_tj_mi: a store that has not opened cannot be the nearest store to a house you buy today. It is kept here, flagged, so the layer stays a complete record and a later rebuild picks it up automatically once its status flips. Never silently count it.
_schema: locations[]: brand, name, store_number, town, county, state, address, status, lat, lon, geocode_precision. `town`/`county` are the STORE's own location and are mostly NOT target towns — do not join on them.
_caveats: Straight-line miles from a town's zip centroid to the store, NOT drive time. The real drive is roughly 1.3-1.5x in this part of NJ. Never quote it as a commute.
Measured TOWN-to-store, so it is identical for every house in a town. A house's own address does not move it.
North Jersey only, as supplied. A town near an unlisted store (e.g. further south) would read as further from a TJ than it really is.
10 of 11 stores are open; West Orange is coming_soon and does not count toward any distance (see _status_rule).
